title: 자동 중국물량표 패킹리스트 박스 배정 계약

actions.name: CHINA_PACKING_LOCAL_EDIT
actions.source: browser memory until explicit WebChinaVolumeBoard save

actions.name: CHINA_VOLUME_BOARD_SAVE
actions.source: explicit user save for a BoardKey in the selected OrderYear + OrderWeek scope

actions.name: CHINA_VOLUME_BOARD_DELETE
actions.source: explicit user delete of a saved BoardKey work copy
actions.deletePolicy: soft delete only; the BoardKey JSON, packing file, matching rows, cell edits, and audit history remain queryable

actions.name: CHINA_VOLUME_BOARD_MATCH_SAVE
actions.source: explicit user confirmation of a customer/product rematch
actions.matchPolicy: never silently promote an ambiguous or unmatched row; save the selected CustKey/ProdKey and before/after mapping in history

criteriaLedger.boxSource: packing list column B Box No.
criteriaLedger.customerSource: packing list Customer code matched to Customer.OrderCode
criteriaLedger.productSource: 활성 Product 마스터의 중국 품목 전체를 읽기 전용 매칭 후보로 사용하되, 표에는 선택 차수 피벗 품목과 업로드에서 실제 매칭된 품목만 표시한다.
criteriaLedger.productSearch: 괄호·공백·하이픈·ROSE/CARNATION 같은 화종 표기를 정규화해 SOLOMIO ROSE PINK가 Solomio Rose (pink)를 찾는다.
criteriaLedger.display: quantity cell dimensions remain fixed; matched invoice/packing quantity is the primary value and ERP order quantity remains a separate comparison value; both stay above box badge expansion layers; red box badges use one deterministically reserved empty neighbor in right-left-down-up order without covering nonempty cells; badge width follows digit count
criteriaLedger.defaultWeek: 35-01; previous/next buttons change only the selected major week and 조회 performs the read
criteriaLedger.uploadPersistence: a successful packing upload immediately saves parsed rows, file name, sheet name and mapping review state without replacing the ERP quantity grid; manual matches update the review snapshot, and only an explicit apply after every row is matched saves invoice quantities and box allocations as the applied page
criteriaLedger.matchingFlow: show the ERP quantity board first; keep invoice source rows and current customer/product mapping visible in the right comparison panel; both unmatched and already matched source rows can explicitly select a different customer and product; a rematch resets only that immutable source row's working distribution to the newly selected cell for the full invoice quantity and then opens box distribution; each matched invoice row may be split into one or more customer-product cells, but its distribution total must exactly equal the immutable invoice quantity; preserve original quantity and box numbers while splitting quantities; block apply for every unmatched or incompletely distributed row; only the explicit apply action changes the displayed packing quantities and enables the final workbook
criteriaLedger.productLabel: strip leading CHINA / only; preserve the full remaining product name in web and workbook
criteriaLedger.excelExport: current displayed quantities and edited box allocations export as quantity (box numbers) plus a 수량대조 audit sheet without ERP writes
criteriaLedger.reconciliationSource: one shared summarizeChinaVolumeTotals helper for screen status, mismatch list, and XLSX audit sheet
criteriaLedger.reconciliationPolicy: packing total equals matched plus unmatched; every customer-product compares packing, current board display, and box allocation without offsetting another cell; visible totals are grouped by Product.unit so box, bunch, and stem are never presented as one meaningful quantity; pivot-versus-packing remains a reference difference because early shipment or carryover can be legitimate
criteriaLedger.reuploadPolicy: a new packing upload replaces prior browser cell state so stale allocations cannot remain
criteriaLedger.downloadWarning: unmatched rows or cell quantity differences require explicit confirmation and remain visible in the 수량대조 sheet

persistence.multipleWorkCopies: multiple BoardKey work copies may coexist for the same OrderYear + OrderWeek; list GET uses the explicit year+week scope, optional detail GET may use BoardKey, and update POST/delete always identify BoardKey explicitly
persistence.rowVersion: every mutable BoardKey row has RowVersion; save/delete requires expectedRowVersion and returns HTTP 409 with no mutation when stale
persistence.uploadRetention: original file metadata, source sheet name, source row, raw customer/item/box text and parsed quantity are retained inside each BoardKey JSON payload
persistence.deleteRetention: delete is a reversible soft-delete of the selected BoardKey work copy; it must not delete ERP rows or erase its packing/matching audit
persistence.staleRevision: save/delete must include BoardKey + expectedRowVersion; a stale token changes zero rows and returns HTTP 409/reload-required
persistence.database: WebChinaVolumeBoard stores PackingRowsJson, CellsJson, MatchOverridesJson and ReviewStateJson for each BoardKey plus source-file metadata; WebChinaVolumeProductMap stores reusable explicit source-item to ProdKey mappings globally across BoardKey and weeks. Both are web-only; no runtime CREATE/ALTER/DROP and no writes to Order*, Shipment*, Warehouse*, Stock*, Estimate or WebProfitReport

mismatchReview.open: a dedicated confirmation button opens a new review window/modal; during REVIEW it compares ERP order quantity with invoice quantity and labels shortage/excess in plain Korean, while after APPLIED it separately verifies invoice, final board and box-allocation totals
choices: leave unresolved and save for later
mismatchReview.requiresReason: choice and optional note are stored in history; unresolved rows remain visible and block a false OK status

excelLayout.sheet: one worksheet matching the web grid layout; the audit sheet is separate
excelLayout.printOnlyPagination: do not split the web data into per-page sheets; set print area/page breaks for A4 printing
excelLayout.style: preserve product/customer headers, large quantity text, red box badges, and digit-aware wrapped box labels in the workbook

crossYearFixture.description: 같은 35-01이 전년도에도 존재해도 BoardKey 목록과 저장/삭제 API는 명시한 OrderYear + OrderWeek만 범위로 사용하며 전년도 작업본을 섞지 않는다. 같은 차수에 여러 BoardKey 작업본이 존재할 수 있다.

dnspyEvidence.source: FormQuantityPivot read-only 수량 표시를 재사용하며 박스 배정은 ERP 원장을 변경하지 않는 웹 표시 기능이다.
